chunks.title: Create deterministic SQLite schema setup
acceptance_criteria: A repository-owned command creates the users, games, and moves schema through PDO SQLite
Schema setup is deterministic and idempotent against a fresh or already initialized database
Database files and SQLite journal artifacts are ignored while schema definitions remain reviewable
Focused tests use isolated temporary databases and leave no repository state behind

chunks.title: Build typed user and game repositories
acceptance_criteria: User, game, and move persistence is isolated behind repository classes with parameterized queries
Game and ordered move writes are transaction-safe and reload the same canonical state
Duplicate usernames and invalid foreign-key relationships fail predictably without partial writes
Repository tests cover create, read, list, update, and rollback behavior

chunks.title: Implement local registration and authentication services
acceptance_criteria: Registration validates username, display name, and password and enforces normalized username uniqueness
Passwords are stored only through PHP password_hash and verified through password_verify
Authentication results expose safe user identity data and never return password hashes
Focused tests cover valid registration/login and duplicate, invalid, and wrong-password paths

chunks.title: Add session-backed account HTTP contracts
acceptance_criteria: Register, login, logout, and current-user endpoints enforce methods and stable JSON envelopes
Successful authentication rotates the PHP session identifier and logout clears only authentication context
Responses never expose hashes, raw passwords, SQL details, or other users' data
API documentation and dynamic probes cover method, malformed-input, and session-transition behavior

chunks.title: Persist owned canonical games without breaking guest play
acceptance_criteria: A logged-in owner can save and reload canonical game state plus ordered move records without notation or FEN drift
Ownership checks prevent one local user from loading or mutating another user's games
Guest games remain session-backed and do not create durable account-owned records
Accepted durable writes are atomic and focused integration tests cover save, reload, isolation, and guest behavior
